Definition: properly, a claw, i.e. (human) nail; also the point of a style (or pen, tipped with adamant)
BiblicalUsage: tsippôren is the Bible's word for a fingernail, a claw. In Deuteronomy 21:12, pare her nails, and it appears again in Jeremiah 17:1.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsippôren exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
